messages:
Anika (AE): Hey team — Cypress AI kickoff tomorrow at 10am PT. Need to align on success criteria, security asks, and a quick pricing note from procurement. Can folks confirm availability?

Tom (Solutions Eng): I'm in. Planning to bring a simple eval plan + prompt set. Can we confirm which dataset they'll push for the demo? S3 or sample CSV?

Ravi (Sales Eng): Procurement flagged committed capacity vs pay-as-you-go. They've asked for an estimate of token costs for the 2-week POC and uplift if we enable dedicated capacity. Can engineering provide a rough ballpark?

Jordan (Customer Eng): They want two flows validated: (1) intent classification over support tickets (latency sensitive), (2) multi-turn assistant for internal docs (context window heavy). For (2) they will provide a 20k-row doc index and some convo transcripts.

Priya (Security): Quick heads-up — customer will require completion of our short security intake + their vendor questionnaire before we ship any keys. I uploaded the questionnaire link to the workspace: https://files.example.com/cypress-security-q3. Will need answers on data retention, KMS, and network egress.

Anika (AE): Thanks. For success criteria let's propose: 1) intent classifier >= 88% F1 on their eval set, 2) assistant median latency < 300ms for single-turn queries, 3) no PII leakage found in 50-sample audit. Agree?

Tom (Solutions Eng): Those look good. I'll own the eval harness. Quick ask: do we run hosted Redwood API or Dedicated trial infra for this? Dedicated would help latency numbers but needs lead time.

Ravi (Sales Eng): Procurement prefers hosted for speed, but engineering said Dedicated would be more defensible for SLA. Maybe propose hosted with optional Dedicated for the last 3 days of the POC for final validation?

Priya (Security): That's reasonable. For hosted path we need to confirm VPC peering is not required and that logs are stored in our tenant scope. Also need confirmation of KMS integration for at-rest keys. I'll draft answers to their vendor form if someone can point to the KMS doc.

Tom (Solutions Eng): KMS doc: https://internal.redwood/docs/kms-integration. I can paste the short snippet in the intake form. Also for latency baseline I recommend we 1) run a 1k-request smoke test with seq_len=512 and measure p50/p95.

Jordan (Customer Eng): Timeline constraints: customer wants results in 10 business days. Proposed schedule: Day 0 onboarding/data ingest, Days 1-3 evals and prompt tuning, Days 4-7 stress tests and latency tuning, Days 8-10 final report + dedicated run if needed. Sound tight?

Anika (AE): Sounds okay. We should set a cut-over date for Dedicated provisioning if we choose it — usually >=72 hours lead. Put a conditional in the kickoff agenda.

security-bot: Reminder: please complete "Vendor Security Intake" doc in the shared drive by EOD Fri. Link: https://vault.example.com/vendor-intake

Priya (Security): I'll take the vendor form and the KMS/Q access questions. Tom — can you provide the small script we use to scrub PII and the checklist for the 50-sample audit?

Tom (Solutions Eng): Yep. Will drop the scrub script and audit checklist in the kickoff folder by EOD today. Snippet: ```python
# basic scrub example
def scrub(text):
    return re.sub(r"\\\\b\\d{3}-\\d{2}-\\d{4}\\\\b", "[REDACTED]", text)
```

Ravi (Sales Eng): Pricing note for the kickoff: I'll share two estimates in the kickoff deck — hosted pay-as-you-go projection (token-based) and a short reserved capacity quote for 10 days. Need typical token/sec numbers for their workload (Tom?)

Tom (Solutions Eng): For intent classifier traffic pattern (burst to 20 qps, avg seq 64) expect ~200 tokens/sec per vCPU baseline; hosted endpoint with batching should be fine. I'll give a range in the deck: ~$150–$400 for the 2-week POC depending on batching and cache hit rates.

Jordan (Customer Eng): Discovery questions for the meeting — can we add to the agenda: data retention policy, who owns model outputs, legal POC point of contact, and escalation path?

Anika (AE): Added. Draft kickoff agenda (10am PT, 45m):
- 0-5m: intros + goals
- 5-15m: customer use case walkthrough (Jordan)
- 15-25m: success criteria & eval plan (Tom)
- 25-35m: security & data handling (Priya)
- 35-40m: pricing & provisioning options (Ravi)
- 40-45m: next steps / action owners

Priya (Security): One more — need to confirm data egress regions (they are EU-based, require EU data residency). If hosted can't guarantee EU-only, we'll need Dedicated in EU or Private.

Ravi (Sales Eng): Noted. I'll flag EU residency in pre-kickoff email and confirm which legal entity will sign the short POC clause.

Anika (AE): OK folks — action items before kickoff: Tom drop eval harness + scrub script, Priya draft vendor form answers, Ravi prepare pricing slide, Jordan confirm dataset access (S3 path) and legal contact. I'll send the calendar invite with links. :thumbsup:

Tom (Solutions Eng): Got it. I'll also prepare one example prompt set for the assistant flow (3 prompt templates + eval rubric).

Jordan (Customer Eng): S3 path shared in DM. Also gave read-only creds to our onboarding bucket.

Anika (AE): Thanks everyone — see you tomorrow.

security-bot: New task created: "Cypress AI - Vendor Intake" assigned to Priya, due by 2026-02-14.
